verdict.rationale: Docs confirm chip/contactless card-present acceptance via smart readers and Tap to Pay on iPhone/Android, plus explicit mobile-wallet contactless support, backed by community hands-on reports of building real POS integrations on Stripe Terminal. missing for 10: independent third-party verification specifically confirming Apple Pay/Google Pay wallet taps (not just NFC contactless) succeeding in production, and broader hands-on reviews beyond one HN thread.
